response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience as a senior software developer across multiple domains, including embedded systems and networking, with strong proficiency in C/C++ and Linux. However, his primary focus has been on high-level applications, web development, and AI infrastructure rather than embedded networking security. His lack of direct experience with LAN-switch products, MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, and chip-vendor SDKs, as well as his limited exposure to Japanese language skills, significantly impacts his fit for this specialized role.
strengths: Strong C/C++ and Linux kernel experience, including source-code modification
Demonstrated ability to work across the full software development lifecycle
Proven track record in collaborative problem-solving and technical leadership
concerns: Limited direct experience with embedded networking security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.)
No evidence of Japanese language proficiency, which is a strict requirement
Mostly web/enterprise-focused experience rather than embedded device development
